author: Caroline Gaspich
title: Jelly Roll says 300 lb weight loss made him 'a whole different human' prior to divorce - NewsBreak
text:
By Caroline Gaspich Niti Majethia ,
35 minutes ago Jelly Roll has revealed how his dramatic weight loss journey has transformed virtually every aspect of his existence, making him feel like a "whole different human."
Speaking with Extra earlier this year, the 41-year-old country musician discussed how dropping 300 lbs had helped him become a better father.
"I've gotten closer to God. I've gotten closer to myself. I'm a better father," said Jelly Roll, born Jason DeFord. "I'm more present with my children. You should see it, dude. I mean, I'm coaching my son's basketball team this year." The country musician's private life has also attracted attention this month, following reports that he has initiated divorce proceedings from his wife , Alisa DeFord, known publicly as Bunnie Xo.

• Michael Jackson's horrifying autopsy from grim tattoo to 'rotting feet'
In the same Extra interview, Jelly Roll discussed openly about feeling "physically better" after his remarkable weight loss.
"They're kids, like I'm not coaching like a competitive team or anything here, but ... I just feel physically better, and I feel like I can physically do [things]," Jelly Roll said.
"Dude, when you're 550 lbs, you wonder if they have a seat big enough for you, you know what I mean? You definitely don't think about coaching a team. You wonder if there's a bench you can sit on, you know? So, it's like for God to just even make that big of a difference [and] to have the weight off...I'm a whole different human."
Before their split, the All My Life hitmaker and Bunnie Xo had openly shared their plans to expand their family through IVF.
While speaking to Access Hollywood at the 2025 Academy of Country Music Awards on May 8, the country star confirmed that he and his wife were actively pursuing their IVF journey.
"For all of our friends out there who have been supporting and praying for us that know the journey we are on, y'all know how hard it is, thanks for praying for us. We're still trying," he stated.
Additionally, during a June 2024 appearance on the Bussin' with the Boys podcast, Jelly Roll opened up about his goal to lose over 60 pounds in order to live longer.
"My wife and I are talking about having a baby, and it really made me realize that at almost 40, I was like, it means I got to live to at least 60," Jelly Roll explained. "I got to see this kid into college."
Sadly, the couple's dreams never came to fruition, and news of their breakup left fans stunned. The pair had tied the knot back in August 2016. Roughly one week before the wedding, Jelly Roll allegedly fathered a son with another woman.
Beyond his troubled marriage, Jelly Roll has also faced setbacks with his recent touring commitments. On June 2, Post Malone delivered disappointing news to fans, abruptly canceling six tour dates.
Supporters are speculating the musician might be leaning toward MAGA after an Instagram post from Kristi Noem showed images of the two embracing and smiling together.
